meta.title: Swimming Lessons at School
meta.textType: a post on the class blog

paragraphs: Swimming Lessons at School, posted by May. Hello, readers of Explorers' Blog! Do you want to learn to swim? This school year, the school pool has new swimming lessons. This post describes the days, the times, and the groups. The pool is next to the school gym, and the water is clean and cool. Many children asked for lessons last year. Coach Matt and Teacher Kim made a plan.

There are two groups, and both groups have lessons on weekdays. Each lesson is one hour long, and it starts at half past three. The lesson ends at half past four. Parents can wait at the school gate. Coach Matt teaches both groups. Every lesson starts with a warm walk around the pool. A beginner wears a yellow cap, and an advanced swimmer wears a blue cap. He wears his red sports shirt, and he has a silver whistle. Lily asked him about the groups, and he gave her the plan.

The beginner group is for children who cannot swim yet. The lessons are on Monday and Wednesday. The first lesson is a little hard, but it is also fun. Coach Matt is kind, and he waits for every child. First, a beginner learns to put the face in the water. Then the children learn to float on their backs. After that, they learn to kick with their legs. In the last lesson of the month, a beginner can swim a short way.

The advanced group is for children who swim well. The lessons are on Tuesday and Thursday. The children swim many lengths and learn to breathe at the right time. They also learn to turn at the end of the pool. Coach Matt says that the advanced group must come on time.

On the last Friday of each month, there is a monthly swim test. The test is at half past three, and both groups can join. The test is not a race. Each child swims at a speed that is good for the child. Please bring a swimsuit, a towel, and a slim bag. The lockers are small, so a big bag does not fit. Which group do you want to join? Swimming is good for your body, and it is fun with friends. Tell us in a message, and we will write your name on the list! Posted by May.
text.summary: May writes a post on Explorers' Blog about the new swimming lessons at school. She gives the days and the times for the beginner and advanced groups and the monthly test, and she asks the readers to join.
